## Description

Use a 2-period RSI plus trend and closing-location filters for short-horizon oversold entries.

## Where it may fit

Short-term pullbacks inside a broader uptrend in liquid, mean-reverting equities.

## Vehicles

Large-cap stocks, equity ETFs and liquid futures.

## Required data

Daily OHLC/adjusted close; short RSI; longer trend average; corporate actions and realistic costs.

## Caveats

Frequent turnover and overnight gaps can erase small gross edges.
